label.description: Name of the step in the log. Defaults to the action name. For macros and player.talk_to the label is applied to every node the step expands into.

timeout.description: Seconds the step may run before it fails. Replaces the step's own default timeout where it has one (see timeout_default on each step). For macros and player.talk_to the value applies to every expanded node.

optional.description: When true a failure is logged and the script goes on.

steps.name: wait
steps.description: Waits for secs seconds.

steps.name: wait_until
steps.description: Waits until the condition holds, failing at its timeout.

steps.name: assert
steps.description: Asserts that a condition holds at this point of the script.

steps.name: log
steps.description: Writes text to the log.

steps.name: where
steps.description: Logs the player's position and the position of each listed target.

steps.name: capture
steps.description: Saves the next rendered frame.

steps.name: parallel
steps.description: Runs several step lists as concurrent tracks; join all ends when every track has ended, join any ends when one track has ended and stops the others.

steps.name: repeat
steps.description: Runs the nested steps a fixed number of times.

steps.name: player.walk_to
steps.description: Walks the player to a target, stopping within the within tolerance.

steps.name: player.interact
steps.description: Walks the player to a target and presses an action button there; stop is the distance at which it stops (default 0.2).

steps.name: player.talk_to
steps.description: Walks the player to an NPC, presses its Talk button, then waits for a talk to become active.
steps.expansion: player.interact with target {npc: unit, offset [0,0]}, button Talk, stop (default 0.8), timeout 60; then wait_until talk_active, timeout 10. Common label, timeout and optional apply to both nodes.
steps.timeout_rule: 60 for the interact node, 10 for the wait_until node

steps.name: player.stick
steps.description: Holds the joystick at a stick ratio for secs seconds.

stick.description: [x, y] ratio, x right, y up.

constraints: hypot(stick) <= 1 + 1e-4 (the ratio lies within the unit circle); refused at parse time

steps.name: player.release
steps.description: Lifts the joystick finger.

steps.name: player.wear
steps.description: Dresses the player's body as the character body of the given unit.

steps.name: player.wear_avatar
steps.description: Dresses the player's body as the avatar body; the step ends once the choice is made.

steps.name: tap
steps.description: Taps one point, given either in logical pixels (at) or as window fractions (at_fraction); exactly one of the two must be present.

at_fraction.description: [x, y] as fractions of the window (0..1 by the documented meaning;

steps.name: ui.tap
steps.description: Taps the centre of the node at path in the UI view named view.

steps.name: npc.take
steps.description: Takes the roster character of the given unit under script control.

steps.name: npc.walk_to
steps.description: Walks a taken character to a target, stopping within the within tolerance; rests keeps the walk law's rest stops on the route.

steps.name: npc.release
steps.description: Gives a taken character back to its AI.

steps.name: npc.face
steps.description: Turns a taken, standing character toward a target over secs seconds.
steps.timeout_rule: secs + 5 (computed from secs when the step is parsed)

steps.name: npc.emote
steps.description: Shows the named emoticon over a character for secs seconds.

steps.name: npc.use
steps.description: Plays one of a character's authored no-talk activities at a placed fixture; activity picks the action by id and variant (1-based) picks its timeline, with the first of each when absent.

oneOf.description: Master id; the nearest placed instance is used.

steps.name: npc.tweet
steps.description: Shows a tweet of the master over a taken character for secs seconds.

steps.name: npc.talk
steps.description: Hands a character to its AI with the given talk set to open on its next decision.

steps.name: companion.spawn
steps.description: Puts the companion of unit at a world point [x, y, z]. The step ends once its body is in and it stands, or has walked from its seat to the point; it fails with the status reason when the companion refuses the spawn.

steps.name: companion.walk_to
steps.description: Walks the companion of unit to a world point [x, y, z], finishing within within metres of it; the step ends when the walk does and fails with the status reason when it cannot be walked.

within.description: Metres; the walk accepts at most 5.

steps.name: companion.face
steps.description: Turns the companion of unit to face a world point [x, y, z], or the player ("player": the position the player stands at when the step starts), over secs seconds linearly; secs 0 turns it at once. The step ends when the turn is done and fails with the status reason when the companion refuses it (it is not spawned, its body is still loading, or a build or a walk is in flight).
steps.timeout_rule: secs + 5 (computed from secs when the step is parsed)

oneOf.description: The player's position when the step starts.

steps.name: companion.emote
steps.description: Shows the named emoticon (a key of moly://emoticons/emoticons.json, such as fx_emote_001) over the companion of unit for secs seconds; the step ends once the emote has gone.

steps.name: companion.motion
steps.description: Plays the motion-library motion motion (a motion of the shared motion library, such as mov_cw_happy_01joy001, as a tweet row names it) on the companion of unit's own body: its start segment motion_S, then its loop segment motion_L once when the library has one, then its end segment motion_E when it has one, then the body's idle. The step ends when the chain has played. It fails with the reason when the body has no own motion, the motion library is not loaded, the library has no start segment motion_S, or a build, turn or another motion is in flight; a walk in flight is stopped where it is.

motion.description: The motion family name, such as mov_cw_happy_01joy001 (the suffix segments are found by it).

steps.name: companion.expression
steps.description: Sets the eye pattern (eye) and/or the mouth pattern (mouth) of the companion of unit's body, as a tweet row's eye and mouth do (a pattern name of moly://facial-tables.json, such as smile, normal, smile01 or smile02); reset true returns the body to the default face of its unit instead. The step ends at once and fails with the reason when the facial tables are not loaded or its unit has no default face.

reset.description: Return to the unit's default face; takes neither eye nor mouth.

steps.name: companion.balloon
steps.description: Shows a tweet balloon over the companion of unit for secs seconds: the text of the tweet master's row tweet (with their line breaks), or text as given (one of the two). The balloon hangs over the companion's head as the roster's balloons do, and is hidden when the step ends.

tweet.description: Tweet master row id whose text the balloon shows.

steps.name: companion.despawn
steps.description: Removes the companion of unit; the step ends once it is gone.

steps.name: companion.build
steps.description: Has the companion of unit build an owned fixture. The fixture is put on the tile the editor's own put search finds nearest near (a world point; by default 1.5 m in front of the companion), or, with at, on exactly the cell that world point falls in, and saved to the layout, and stands as a ghost; only one layout save is out at a time, so a build whose turn has not come waits for the save in flight until its timeout; the companion walks beside it and hammers it, and each of swings hits makes it more solid until it is solid. The step ends when the fixture is built, and its answer names the saved cell and direction (the layout is saved mirrored in x, so a left direction is saved as right and the other way round); it fails with the reason when the put (including an at cell that cannot take the fixture), the save or the build is refused.

fixture.description: Master id of an owned fixture with a placeable copy.

texture.description: Texture id; any owned texture when absent.

near.description: [x, y, z] world point the put search starts from.

at.description: [x, y, z] world point: the fixture is put on the cell it falls in, with no search, or the step fails with the refusal. Not together with near.

direction.description: Direction number of the put fixture: 0 front, 1 left, 2 back, 3 right (the number a camera yaw of 90 times it degrees gives). The field camera's yaw decides when absent.

swings.description: Hammer hits from ghost to solid.

steps.name: companion.use
steps.description: Has the companion of unit use a placed fixture: the nearest placed copy of the master id fixture, or the fixture uid. The action is its character's own action at that fixture, a no-talk action or the pre-action one of its talks holds there (the one activity and variant name, or the first, no-talk actions before pre-actions): the companion walks to the action's point, plays the action's timeline on its own body standing on the action's start locator, and ends on its end locator. The step ends when the action has ended and fails with the reason when the fixture is not placed, the character has no action there, no action point is reachable and free, the walk stops short, or a build or another use is in flight.

fixture.description: Master id of a placed fixture; its copy nearest the companion is used.

activity.description: Id of the no-talk action row or of the pre-action row; the first row at the fixture when absent.

variant.description: Index of the row's action; the first when absent.

steps.name: effect.play
steps.description: Shows an emoticon (a particle or a sprite one, such as fx_emote_018_single) at a world point [x, y, z] for secs seconds, on an anchor entity of its own; the step ends once the emote has gone.

steps.name: camera.drag
steps.description: Drags with one finger by by logical pixels over secs seconds, starting at from (window fractions).

by.description: [x, y] pixels; x right, y down.

from.description: [x, y] window fractions; each must lie in 0..1.

steps.name: camera.zoom
steps.description: Turns the wheel by by pixels (positive zooms in) spread over secs seconds.

steps.name: server.edit
steps.description: Sends one server.edit command built from the step's own fields; the server model checks the edit when the step runs.

path.description: Field path, for a value edit.

action.description: Action name, for an action edit.

steps.name: weather.set
steps.description: Sets the weather to the given phenomenon id.

steps.name: site.switch
steps.description: Waits until the entry has opened movement and gestures (control_open), then switches the active site to the named site.
steps.expansion: wait_until control_open, timeout 30; then the site switch, timeout 60. Common label, timeout and optional apply to both nodes.
steps.timeout_rule: 30 for the wait and 60 for the switch; a given timeout applies to both

steps.name: site.enter_room
steps.description: Macro: waits until the entry has opened control, walks to the house entry box, presses HouseEntry, then waits for the move to start and to land in a room.
steps.expansion: wait_until control_open, timeout 30; then player.interact with target house_door, button HouseEntry, stop 0.2, timeout 60; then wait_until site_moving, timeout 5; then wait_until all[not site_moving, site_kind room], timeout 60. Common label, timeout and optional apply to all four nodes.

steps.name: site.go_home
steps.description: Macro: waits until the entry has opened control, walks to the room door sensor, presses GoHomeSite, then waits for the move to start and to land on the home site.
steps.expansion: wait_until control_open, timeout 30; then player.interact with target room_door, button GoHomeSite, stop 0.2, timeout 60; then wait_until site_moving, timeout 5; then wait_until all[not site_moving, site_kind home], timeout 60. Common label, timeout and optional apply to all four nodes.

steps.name: player.gather
steps.description: Harvests one gatherable through the harvest button and then walks over the drops it leaves. The object is chosen once, when the step starts; the harvest screen's own rules (the tool the kind needs, the stamina, the hit points) decide each press.

oneOf.description: The nearest gatherable not yet harvested, of kind when kind is given.
Harvest object UID of the loaded site.

kind.description: Only narrows gatherable "nearest": the kind word of its fixture type (wood, mineral, plant, treasure_box_transport, treasure_box_fixed, other, tone, toolbox, driftage, birthday_plant).

collect.description: Walk over the drops the object leaves.

constraints: kind is refused together with a gatherable UID (it only narrows "nearest")
a site with no gatherable left, and a press the harvest button refuses, fail the step with what was read

steps.name: player.craft
steps.description: Walks to a workbench, opens the craft screen, then crafts one blueprint: its choice, the apply button, the confirm's OK and the result's close.
steps.expansion: player.interact with the named fixture, button OpenCraftTool, stop 0.2, timeout 60; then the craft node, timeout 60. With workbench false only the craft node runs, on the screen already open. Common label, timeout and optional apply to both nodes.
steps.timeout_rule: 60 for each of the two nodes

blueprint.description: Blueprint (recipe) id, as moly.observe reports it.

oneOf.description: Master id; the nearest placed instance is used.
Craft on the screen already open.

workbench.description: The workbench to open; the nearest placed craft tool fixture when absent.

constraints: a blueprint the craft screen refuses (its term, its materials, the server) fails the step with the refusal it shows

steps.name: layout.place
steps.description: Puts one owned fixture through the layout editor's own commands, the ones moly.layout.command sends: opens the editor, selects the first catalog row of the fixture (and texture) with a placeable copy, turns it a quarter turn rotate times, moves it onto the tile, decides it and saves. The editor stays open afterwards.

fixture.description: Master id of the owned fixture.

texture.description: Catalog texture to pick; the first placeable row of the fixture when absent.

center.description: [x, y, z] tile to move the fixture onto; y follows the column height.

decide.description: Decide the placement when the editor's put status allows it.

save.description: Save the draft once the fixture is placed; a save confirmation is answered with its OK.

constraints: rotate above 3 is refused at parse time
a fixture with no placeable owned copy, a put the editor refuses, and a center the editor keeps elsewhere fail the step with its own put status and feedback

steps.name: player.deliver
steps.description: Presses the delivery button on a birthday party in session, holds it (hold seconds, or until the party has nothing left to deliver) and releases it; the step ends once the end action has run and reports the points the party gained.

party.description: Birthday party id; the first party in session when absent.

hold.description: Seconds to hold the button; the whole delivery when absent.

constraints: a press with no birthday party in session fails with no birthday party is in session
a press the delivery flow refuses fails with the state and the count it read

steps.name: dialog.answer
steps.description: Taps the shown common dialog's OK (ok) or cancel button and ends once the dialog is gone. A sub-window dialog with no common button (the learn-phenomenon one) is answered with the back key its own class takes; another family's dialog is left alone and named.

ok.description: OK instead of cancel; a one-button dialog has no cancel.

steps.name: key.back
steps.description: Presses and releases the back key (Escape) in one frame, as a keyboard does. The screen manager gives it to the topmost dialog, else to the header back button and the scene's own back-key process.

conditions.name: site_moving
conditions.description: A site move (cannon or door) is in progress.

conditions.name: entry_done
conditions.description: The entry sequence has ended, including the stamina refresh clip when the join reports one.

conditions.name: talk_active
conditions.description: A player or NPC conversation is playing.

conditions.name: camera_settled
conditions.description: The camera has left its entry shot and no transition tween is in flight.

conditions.name: any
conditions.description: At least one listed condition holds.

conditions.name: not
conditions.description: The inner condition does not hold.

conditions.name: site_is
conditions.description: The active site type equals the given string, for example home_site or first_floor.

conditions.name: site_kind
conditions.description: The active site is of the given kind.

conditions.name: button_head
conditions.description: The action button shown at the head of the button stack is this type.

conditions.name: button_stacked
conditions.description: An action button of this type is in the stack.

conditions.name: phenomenon_is
conditions.description: The current weather phenomenon id equals the value.

conditions.name: player_near
conditions.description: The player's horizontal distance to the target is within within (default 0.5).

conditions.name: ui_shown
conditions.description: The node at path in the UI view named view is shown and active.

conditions.name: npc_here
conditions.description: The roster character of this unit is on this site with its AI.

conditions.name: npc_action
conditions.description: The character's current action state equals is.

conditions.name: npc_near
conditions.description: The character's horizontal distance to the target is within within (default 0.5).

conditions.name: control_open
conditions.description: The entry has opened movement and gestures (control open); a site move waits for it.

target.description: A place in the world: a named place, a [x, z] point, or an object naming an NPC, a fixture or a point.

oneOf.description: [x, z] world point; no offset is possible in this form.
Master id; the placed instance nearest the player.

offset.description: [dx, dz] metres added on x and z after resolution.

step.description: One step as written in a script: do, the common fields, and the fields of the named action (see steps[i].params). Nested steps (parallel tracks, repeat steps) use this definition.

condition.description: A condition: a bare name, or an object with exactly one key.
